name.zh: 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第八门 萨多拉尼

location.zh: 精灵太空站 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第八门

reward_note: Each door boss, when beaten, gave its 暗黑精灵's 精元 (4399 2010-06-04: 通关后获得精元), hatching the line's first stage.

capture.zh: 暗黑武斗场暗黑第八门：100级萨多拉尼，约1500血。打败获得萨多拉尼精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 需要运气，速度超快、强制先手、高致命，可能每轮被秒；带血厚的精灵轮换。

engine_notes: Entry (original): 超能NoNo owners loaded the 反物质芯片 directly; others needed NoNo AI level 10 and a crafted 反物质芯片 (VIP-gated). Doors open in order: 试炼之门, then 暗黑第一门 … 第九门 (pre-2013). The remake drops the VIP gate.
always_move_first: 强制先手. crit_rate_bonus: '高致命' — its attacks crit far more often than normal; +2 crit stages is an estimate.
Some later lists call this door's third boss 萨拉多尼; 4399 (2011) gives 萨多拉尼 No.661 龙系. Level not given; 100 assumed.
Innate attack boost +2 (天生攻击强化等级+2).
source_note: 4399 第八门全程攻略: No.661 龙系 HP≈1500, 速度超快 有先手招 高致命.
